releases.impact: Strip unsupported uniqueItems schema keyword while preserving literal properties; Home-backed scheduler continuity only when Home selected; Antigravity probe/changelist changes are outside active providers.
releases.assessment_boundary: Tagged source assessed for active-provider, config, management, plugin and security impact; exact runtime scenarios only those named in the gates. Other-provider/Home/UI/catalog changes are source-only.

upstream_assessment.runtime_boundary: Only named synthetic gates are runtime verification; other-provider/Home/TUI/catalog and un-injected fault paths are source-only.

live_config_key_assessment.comparison: present key names/types versus tagged v8 mappings and allowed roots; not a production config PATCH

decisions_and_risks: New always-registered authenticated /v1/tunnel surface uses inference keys including query keys; origins permissive, realms isolated; preserve firewall restrictions.
New durable .codex-refresh receipts contain secrets and no-replay state; rollback to 8.0.47 after uncertain refresh requires reconciliation rather than restoring old grants.
Local KV explicitly disabled: session/date-pin/replay state stays in memory, preserving 8.0.47 behavior; no permanent Claude date pins and no bbolt backup method needed.
Claude native fingerprint/fallback/connection-reuse/new-login scope behavior changed; real client acceptance still needed.
Response steering remains explicitly off; late payload rules can override plugin tiers.
One remaining live Codex account limits capacity recovery; upgrade is not a general 429 cure.
Rollback removes the future KV key before starting 8.0.47 because strict PATCH rejects it; stop 8.0.79 first so removal cannot hot-enable default KV.
